## Checklist

- [ ] Each commit is one logical change, titled `<type>: <short description>` (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and each one can fail for a real defect
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] The README, `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` match the change, where it affects them
- [ ] Only example values: RFC 5737 IPs, `example.com` hostnames, usernames like `alice`
